concerns_addressed: The correction keeps the JWT guard and protected authentication behavior intact; the public /api/auth/register onboarding contract remains unchanged and still performs server-side outlet-user binding.
The corrected outlet/product callers and tests use Bearer JWT headers, and the cross-task integration path remains authenticated without manual association.
The API regression suite passes (36 tests, 187 assertions) and the corrected web workspace builds successfully; no T1 authentication regression was found.

strengths: Authentication boundaries remain centralized in the existing auth:api middleware and shared browser auth-header helper.
Existing authentication and order authorization behavior remains green after the route and caller changes.

issues.description: PHPUnit uses SQLite in-memory while CI and Docker use PostgreSQL; enum behavior can therefore diverge locally.
Spatie packages installed for future work are not used by the T1 implementation.
Docker Compose version 3.8 is deprecated in Docker Compose v2.
Shared package exports product/order/dashboard types beyond the T1 foundation scope.
